verdicts.reason: 真实链路：owned App(artifact A)指派到 owned child → Hub sync 下发 artifact_url/sha256 → Agent 从真实 Hub /api/artifacts/<A>/download 下载 → artifacts/<sha> 存在、size=4096 等于 Hub 声明、重算 SHA 匹配、无 .tmp、SQLite 行存在且 quick_check ok、Agent 日志 artifact cached。
limitations: The atomicity evidence is the absence of any .tmp/partial file plus a byte-exact final SHA; a crash exactly inside the rename window was not forced.
No browser UI was exercised; the caller-side feedback is the Hub API readback (application assignment + artifact metadata) plus the download endpoint response captured with Agent identity.

The Hub download probe recorded X-Artifact-Sha256 under Go canonical casing (X-Artifact-Sha256); an initial case-sensitive lookup reported null and was corrected (harness bug, see evidence/phase2b-hub-download-header.json).

verdicts.reason: 经 frame proxy 注入 ARTIFACT_PREFETCH（期望 SHA 为不匹配值）→ 真实 Agent 拒绝，日志 sha256 mismatch；负向证明期望 SHA 与服务 body SHA 均无缓存文件/无 DB 行/无 .tmp。
limitations: The mismatch is produced by a harness-controlled pairing (expected SHA vs served bytes); product source was not modified and the Hub was not stopped/restarted.
An artifact-prefetch failure surfaces only in the owned Agent process log; the Hub has no artifact-prefetch status API/UI surface, so the negative-path caller feedback is that log line.

verdicts.reason: HTTP 404 → download status 404；中断（服务端声明 8192 只发 200 后断开）传输中亲见 <sha>.tmp(200B)、失败后 unexpected EOF 且 .tmp 清理；超时（黑洞 192.0.2.1）i/o timeout ~30s。三者均无残留。
limitations: The agent builds its HTTP client from http.DefaultClient with no response-read/idle timeout and passes the agent-lifetime context, so the "timeout" dimension exercised is the transport dial timeout. A supplemental bounded test (evidence/phase10-stall-observation.json) shows a server that sends headers and then withholds the body leaves a 0-byte .tmp in place for >24s: there is no read timeout. Reported as a robustness observation, not a required-dimension failure.
Prefetch failures surface only in the owned Agent log; there is no Hub-side artifact-prefetch status API/UI to observe them.

verdicts.reason: 对 C 注入中断（.tmp 亲见→清理）→ 经 APP-C Desired State 真实恢复下载成功；幂等（重指派+重发同帧：mtime/downloaded_at/行数不变、无新安装日志、无 .tmp）；重启 owned child 后文件+行+SHA 仍在且 quick_check ok；Desired==Actual。
limitations: The interruption itself is harness-injected (frame proxy + owned HTTP server); the recovery, idempotency and persistence steps use the real product path.

Concurrent prefetch of the same SHA is not de-duplicated: two sync-triggered goroutines each logged "artifact cached" for the same SHA within ~20ms. Final state stayed consistent (atomic rename, identical bytes), so this is an observation, not a failed dimension.

verdicts.reason: A 首次被喂错字节 → sha256 mismatch 拒绝安装；随后 APP-A 真实恢复成功；幂等/持久化/Desired==Actual 同上。
limitations: The initial SHA failure is harness-injected (wrong bytes served by an owned HTTP server); recovery/idempotency/persistence use the real product path.
